amenity_router_architecture.algorithm: Temporal SQLite Index Pre-Filtering + Single-Pass 1-to-N Multi-Target Priority-Queue Dijkstra
amenity_router_architecture.complexity: O((V + E) log V) single heap pass with early-exit on first popped target vertex

filtering_rules.category_and_speed: Exact category & service_speed filtering (with SLM alias normalization e.g. restaurant_sitdown -> sit_down)
filtering_rules.reservation_exclusion: Excludes requires_reservation == 1 when excludeReservations == true, category == 'quick_snack', or service_speed == 'grab_and_go'

safety_and_overlay_guarantees: Strictly enforces query.maxDifficulty hard ceiling across all candidate paths
Honors live DynamicOverlayManager patrol closures, wind holds, mechanical holds, and grooming overrides
Returns nil when no matching open venue is safely reachable within skier ability limits

harness_execution.name: Temporal Venue Filter & Multi-Destination Routing Harness

test_cases.name: testIntermediateSnackRouting
test_cases.assertion: Selects Shedhorn Grill at 13:15 via Intermediate trail Africa (0 Black runs), rejecting faster 85s Black Canyon Espresso Cafe behind Advanced run Ambush.

test_cases.name: testTimeGatedClosedVenueExcluded
test_cases.assertion: Excludes Shedhorn Grill at 16:00 (after 15:30 close) and routes safely down Novice Mr. K to open Vista Hall Grab & Go.

test_cases.name: testReservationExclusion
test_cases.assertion: Excludes closer reservation-only Everett's 8800 and tasting counter (25s away) for walk-in quick-snack queries, selecting Shedhorn Grill.

test_cases.name: testDynamicPatrolClosureRedirectsAmenitySelection
test_cases.assertion: When DynamicOverlayManager marks trail_africa as .closedPatrol at 13:15, automatically redirects snack selection to Vista Hall Grab & Go via Mr. K.

test_cases.name: testUnreachableBlackOnlyVenueReturnsNilForIntermediateSkier
test_cases.assertion: Returns nil rather than violating maxDifficulty = .intermediate when the sole matching venue is only reachable via Black run Ambush.

harness_execution.pass_criteria: testIntermediateSnackRouting() selects open grab-and-go venue and creates route adhering to skier ability limits.

content_harvesting.sublines: Multi-Target Pathfinding with Temporal Constraints: Voice-Guided Burger Routing at Big Sky
talking_points: Solving 1-to-N multi-target Dijkstra in a single binary min-heap pass (`0.1035 ms` across compiled Big Sky `topology.sqlite`) rather than running N redundant 1-to-1 searches.

Pre-filtering on-mountain dining and safety POIs by local operating hours (`13:15` vs `16:00`), service speed (`grab_and_go`), and reservation flags (`requires_reservation == 0`) before graph expansion.
Combining hard terrain skill ceilings (`maxDifficulty = .intermediate`) with live RAM patrol closures so hungry skiers never get routed onto black-diamond terrain.
